notes.title: Bitsummit : Summer of Yokai !
notes.content: [p]🎉 Taste of Heaven is heading to BitSummit in Kyoto! 🎌[/p][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that Taste of Heaven has been officially selected for BitSummit 2025, Japan’s leading indie game festival ![/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ Date: July 19–21[/p][p]📍 Location: Kyoto, Miyako Messe[/p][p][/p][p]Come meet us in person and get your hands on our playable demo,[/p][p]We will also have some pretty cool gift 🎁[/p][p][/p][p]See you there ![/p][p][/p][p]Chromatic Dream[/p]

notes.title: Steam cooking fest !
notes.content:
Taste of heaven is joining the cooking fest !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282808/a983d7b23e4a315378787b4bda32cbd62b9c7537.png[/img]

notes.title: Taste of Heaven crowdfunding
notes.content:
Hi there

We have launched our first crowdfunding with the objective of releasing the game in around a year from now, we have many stretch goals that will allow us to shape this roguelike experience, add many more more customers, bosses, items and relationship with creatures ! 

For details please consult or KKBB page :

[url=https://www.kisskissbankbank.com/en/projects/tasteofheaven]Taste of heaven Kiss Kiss Bank Bank[/url]

Thank you for your support

notes.title: Taste Of Heaven at the game cup 3rd Edition
notes.content:
We are so proud to announce that Taste of Heaven has been selected for the final phase of the GameCup 3 (French Video games cup). 

We need all your votes during this phase, from July 18 to July 30.

[url=https://www.lagamecup.com/presentation-des-projets-newbie/]https://www.lagamecup.com/presentation-des-projets-newbie/[/url]

Many Thanks 🙏
